routeRoster.openusd_native: Unavailable/unqualified in bounded metadata probes; report separately, never score as failure. Addition requires a pre-result protocol amendment.

model.seedPolicy: Do not invent provider seed support. Record actual support and per-call seed if available before admission.
model.pinStatus: BLOCKED: no executable immutable model snapshot has been selected or verified
model.requiredAdmission: Pin one exact model snapshot, reasoning setting, provider parameters/support, tokenizer/usage semantics and tool schema. A hidden/current chat model identity is insufficient. Any unsupported setting requires a reviewed plan amendment before attempts.

routeInputs.required: Exact versions, binary/package/dependency hashes and verified starting-state equivalence are mandatory before route admission; historical identities alone are insufficient.

design.randomization: Deterministic balanced order, not randomized allocation. Retain order effects as a limitation.
design.crossAttemptState: Fresh workspace and model context; no prior outputs, answers or grader state.

budgets.stopRule: Stop at the first exhausted budget. Preserve unknown in-flight outcomes and reconcile accepted state; do not retry blindly or silently extend limits.
budgets.tokenAccounting: Sum input tokens (including cached input exactly once) plus output tokens across all calls. Cache-read tokens are a subset of input, never added twice. Hidden reasoning tokens count once within provider-reported output. Retain input, cached-input and output separately. If complete consistent usage cannot be established, token efficiency is unscorable, not zero.
budgets.wallAccounting: From dispatch of task/context to terminal submission or timeout; includes model, queue, tool and repair time. Setup/preflight excluded and separately reported.
budgets.toolAccounting: Count every requested call including failures; fixed collector bookkeeping outside author access is reported separately.

scoring.primaryEndpoint: Final end-to-end success proportion over all started valid V1/V2 attempts per admitted route
scoring.firstPass: Same all-checks predicate on first submission
scoring.negativeEndpoint: N1 rejection with exact accepted-state preservation; separate denominator
scoring.unavailableBeforeStart: Coverage limitation, no outcome in attempted denominator
scoring.postStartFailure: Count unsuccessful in primary operational denominator; retain cause
scoring.infrastructureSensitivity: Secondary summary excludes only externally evidenced incidents; show both counts and keep primary unchanged
scoring.evaluatorMasking: Opaque attempt IDs and locked component scores before route-label join; artifact formats may reveal route, so masking is partial.
scoring.invalidEditBoundary: The staged candidate acceptance decision before any accepted revision/source/artifact replacement. Require an explicit incompatible-dimension rejection from the route/compiler/script/author, with diagnostic provenance classified; harness-only protection is insufficient for route detection credit. Retain all accepted bytes and no transient accepted invalid state.

analysis.primaryEstimand: Difference in final valid-task success: OntoKin minus the qualified direct baseline, equal weight to V1 and V2 and their six repetition pairs; fixed-family descriptive estimate only in this corpus.
analysis.thresholdRule: For a later eligible multi-assembly study, the lower bound of the predeclared 95% cluster interval must be at least +0.20. Current qualification cases are ineligible, so no investment-advantage decision can pass.
analysis.primaryEfficiencyEndpoint: Total input-plus-output model tokens per attempt under the exact accounting rule
analysis.efficiencySummary: Report every attempt. For pairs where both routes succeed, report the median OntoKin/baseline token ratio and paired elapsed/token differences, plus the number and identity of excluded non-joint-success pairs. Never use this selected subset alone as a cost-benefit claim.
analysis.secondaryEffortRule: A prospective efficiency target requires success-difference lower95 bound >= -0.05 and joint-success token-ratio upper95 bound <= 0.70, with all semantic/provenance guardrails. It is secondary and cannot substitute for the unmet primary investment criterion. Current one-family public corpus cannot pass it as an advantage claim.

uncertainty.currentQualification: Publish exact paired counts, all six per-case outcomes, ranges and median token ratios. Population confidence interval is null with reason one public assembly family; do not bootstrap repeated tasks as independent assemblies or print zero-width population intervals.
uncertainty.laterEligibleStudy: Requires a new unseen multi-assembly corpus and prospective sample-size/precision justification before attempts. Freeze its complete manifest and retain family clustering. For the specified prospective rule, use a paired two-stage percentile bootstrap: resample assembly families with replacement, then repetition indices within each sampled family while retaining all task/route pairs; compute equal-family-weight success difference; 20000 draws; Python random.Random seed 253; lower/upper empirical 2.5/97.5 percentiles using sorted index floor((B-1)*p). Report family count, all strata and missing data.
uncertainty.efficiencyInterval: Use the same family/paired-repetition resamples for median joint-success token ratio. If joint-success pairs are absent or an interval is undefined, efficiency decision is inconclusive.
uncertainty.limits: Bootstrap is a prespecified analysis choice, not proof of precision; public exposure, backend differences and few families remain limitations. The qualification corpus provides no population interval.

analysis.multiplicity: Only the success endpoint governs the primary investment criterion. Efficiency is secondary descriptive evidence with a noninferiority safeguard, not an alternative route to declaring the primary criterion passed. Any added baseline or confirmatory endpoint requires a pre-result amendment.
analysis.guardrailRule: Any accepted invalid state, collateral semantic damage or false provenance blocks an expansion recommendation regardless of aggregate score.
analysis.setupCost: Report route scaffold/reference-pack/environment/oracle engineering time, tokens, tool cost and maintenance separately, with exact artifacts. No invented amortization denominator or dollar costs without observed prices.

blockingRequirements: Qualified offline oracle with positive/boundary/adversarial controls
Qualified native artifact readers and minimal trial runner
Qualified Blender starting seed and complete runtime dependency bindings
Frozen exact route roster, equivalent task/reference-pack bindings and starting-state checks
For any advantage study: clean unseen multi-assembly corpus and prospective precision justification
executionAdmission.unknownInputPolicy: Null is a blocker, never a wildcard or instruction to guess. Fill pins in a separate reviewed admission record; changes to budgets/order/endpoints require a versioned protocol amendment before outcomes.
executionAdmission.nextScope: Offline corpus/oracle observation component only; see NEXT-TASK.md

preservedLimits.historicalTolerances: Unchanged; see corpus oracle and SCORING.md
